query:
-- Check all IN and OH races where candidate1 = candidate2 (unopposed primary)
SELECT CONCAT(state_code, '-', district) as race, candidate1_name, candidate2_name, status
FROM house_races 
WHERE state_code IN ('IN','OH') AND candidate1_name = candidate2_name AND candidate1_name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY race;
